name: Crudely Dried Meat
summary: Crudely Dried Meat is stored food taken from the Magram camp in Desolace. The Gelkis use the stolen stores to sustain their fight against the Magram.

sections.title: Meat Stores
sections.body: Magram hunters preserve extra meat so their people can fight between hunts. Uthek the Wise asks you to take those stores from the Magram camp and bring them to Gelkis Village. He gives the meat to the Gelkis, who mean to fight on full bellies.

faq.answer: Crudely Dried Meat is preserved food stored by the Magram in Desolace.
Uthek the Wise wants you to bring the Magram's stored meat to him in Gelkis Village.

faq.q: Why do the Gelkis want it?
aliases: what do they use it for
faq.answer: The Gelkis plan to eat the meat so they can fight the Magram for many days without rest.

faq.q: Where does the meat come from?
faq.answer: The Magram store extra meat at their camp in Desolace, east of Gelkis Village.
